newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Banque du Sud '96 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Banque du Sud '96 profits up.

text.p: Banque du Sud said net profits in 1996 rose to 10.3 million dinars ($9.4 million), up from 9.7 million dinars in 1995.
The Tunisian bank said it will distribute a 0.5 dinar or 10 percent dividend from June 23.
Total balance sheet in 1996 was 987 million dinars compared to 869 million dinars in 1995.
BS in 1996 raised its capital to 75 million dinars from 50 million dinars. Reserves at end of 1996 amounted to 21.1 million dinars.
The state-controlled bank has among its shareholders Italian bank Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena. ($ = 1.097 Tunisian Dinars)
